sentence: Explorers have traveled to the most remote corners of the world.
synonym: the farthest parts of the world
synonymNote: 两者都指世界上最偏远、难以到达的地方

distractors.word: the biggest cities of the world
distractors.note: 大城市是人口密集处，与偏远地方意思相反

distractors.word: the most popular places of the world
distractors.note: 热门地点是人多的地方，不是偏远角落

distractors.word: the nearest towns of the world
distractors.note: 最近的城镇与最偏远的地方意思完全相反
